scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard definition of chain polytopes. Independent mathematical validation has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the canonical Euclidean metric and symmetric twinning of an ordinal sum of nonempty antichains. The general twinned-chain facet description and the resulting centered radius are implied by prior work; the complete optimal-center boxes and their contact stratification are the contributions examined here. Equivalent prior Chebyshev-center or anti-blocking descriptions remain a priority risk. Finite checks corroborate but do not establish universal statements.
title: Incenter boxes and contact strata of layered twinned chain polytopes
